# (src/split/tools/qdot_golden.cu), written by split_qdot_test --write-golden (src/split/tools/qdot_test.cu), which writes only when every dot
# of qdot.cuh is bit for bit ggml-cuda's vec_dot_*_q8_1 (vecdotq.cuh, third_party/strata-ggml, llama.cpp pin 3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d)
# on the same inputs.  Inputs: fixed seeds per format (qdot_golden.cuh make_inputs); a group = 4096 dots in the decode kernels' call order.
# Line: <family> <format> <group> <dots> <input digest> <output digest> [% reason]; digests FNV-1a 64 (inputs: weight bytes then q8_1 blocks of
# the format; outputs: the group's float bits).  Family cuda: every group (written with nvcc --use_fast_math, the split's flags).  Another
# family (hip) has a line only where its bits differ from the cuda line, with the reason after '%'.
